## d349f4dfe492

**Reproduced validator/invariant defect.** A `5x5` grid with color 3 at `(2,2)`
and color 6 at `(2,3)` has two singleton-colored seeds whose placement zones
overlap in **20 cells**. This contradicts the stated invariant that distance-two
diamond neighborhoods do not overlap, yet `self_check` returns `[]`; it checks
only that each color occurs once. The exact grid is retained in
`checks/audit-counterexamples.json`.

The axis contract is also contradictory: `AXES['n_seeds'].valid` declares `1..5`,
but `n_seeds=5` at medium difficulty raises
`ValueError: draw_int('n_seeds'): override 5 outside [2, 3]`. Standalone lint
also reports the missing `RULE_HASH` and unprobeable singleton axes. Defect lint
flags dead helpful textures, degenerate-domain overlap, the accepted minimal
impostor, and `seeds_at_corner` passing `self_check`. Evidence is under
`checks/audit-lint-d349f4dfe492/`,
`checks/audit-defect-d349f4dfe492/`, and
`checks/audit-counterexamples.json`. I did not modify this audit target.

triage.reason: Brief-reviewed under October 3 lightweight policy; preserve reported evidence and findings. Shared-tool requests consolidated separately. No maintainer battery/test/private-solve rerun or automatic training admission.
